The Program

How lease-to-own works with us

No rent-to-own gimmicks. A clear, written path from moving in to holding the deed — built for people who are close to mortgage-ready and want to lock in their home and their price today.

1

Apply & get screened

Every home starts with an application and screening through Hemlane — it takes a few minutes online. Once your application is approved, we reach out to you personally to schedule your showing — and before signing, a mortgage broker confirms you have a realistic path to a loan by the end of the term.

2

Move in & build your down payment

Put down $5,000 in option money at signing, then $200 a month in option installments. Every dollar is credited toward your purchase price at closing — roughly $11–12,000 banked by the time you buy, right in line with a typical down payment.

3

Buy at your locked price

Your purchase price is locked on day one for the full 3-year term — no bidding wars, no surprises if the market moves. We check in on your mortgage readiness at months 12 and 24 so closing day is a formality, not a scramble.

$5,000 option money, credited +$200/mo installments, credited 3-year term Price locked from day one You handle small repairs up to $500

Bartlett Investments is a family-run housing company based in Cookeville, Tennessee. Our homes are built and renovated by Michael Bartlett Construction and managed directly by the owner — so when you apply, tour, or sign, you're dealing with the person whose name is on the company. Questions

Frequently asked questions

How does lease-to-own work here?
You lease the home for 3 years with a written option to buy it at a price locked on day one. You put down $5,000 in option money at signing and pay $200 a month in option installments — all of it credited toward your purchase price when you buy. At any point during the term (typically at the end), you get a mortgage and close, and the home is yours.
What do I need to qualify?
Start with the application and screening on Hemlane — credit, income (generally about 3× the rent), and rental history. Before signing a lease-to-own, a mortgage broker reviews your situation and confirms there's a realistic path to a home loan within the 3-year term. If the path isn't there yet, we'll tell you honestly — and where possible, offer a straight lease instead.
What if I decide not to buy?
The option is yours to use or not. If you don't buy, the option money and installments are non-refundable — that's what holds your price and takes the home off the market for three years. Your lease simply runs its normal course, and there's no penalty beyond losing the option.
Does paying rent help my credit?
It can. On-time payments can be reported to the credit bureaus through our rent-reporting tools, which helps many tenants build the score they need to qualify for their mortgage. We also check in at months 12 and 24 with a mortgage broker so you always know exactly where you stand.
Can I have pets?
Yes — pets are welcome at $50/month per pet plus a $300 one-time pet fee per pet. Some breed restrictions apply; ask us if you're unsure about yours.
Who handles repairs?
You handle small repairs up to $500 — it's your future home, and that's part of keeping the program affordable. The major systems are on us during the lease.
Can I tour a home before applying?
Showings are scheduled after your application is approved. It keeps things serious, protects everyone's time, and approved applicants always get the first look. Apply on Hemlane — it only takes a few minutes — and once you're approved, we'll reach out to schedule your showing.
